description: The Metal Rooster in Chinese astrology: personality, Metal element traits, 1981 and 2041 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Metal Rooster is the Rooster born in a Metal year, one of five versions of the tenth animal. It combines the Rooster's precision with Metal's qualities. Metal Rooster years between 1924 and 2044 are 1981 and 2041. The Rooster's fixed element is Metal.

sections.heading: The Metal Rooster personality
paragraphs: When stem and animal share Metal, as in the Metal Rooster, the sign's precision reaches its sharpest point. Traditional accounts describe a person of strong principles, exceptional focus and tireless work ethic, someone who notices every detail and expects things to be done correctly. Metal Roosters are seen as honest, brave and fiercely self-reliant, with a clear sense of right and wrong. They tend to achieve a great deal through discipline. Doubled Metal can also make them uncompromising, and readings warn of perfectionism, outspoken criticism, difficulty relaxing and an emotional reserve that makes it hard for others to see how much they actually care. Their word, once given, is kept with almost military exactness, and they quietly expect the same of others.

Belonging to the west and to the clear, cool air of autumn, Metal adds edge, resolve and structure to any sign it colours. Classical texts connect it with righteousness, strength of will and the ability to see a situation without sentiment. A Metal stem often makes an animal more ambitious, more organised and more self-contained than usual. People born in Metal years are frequently described as loyal to their word and tireless once committed. The caution most readings add is a hardness that can isolate them, along with perfectionism and a reluctance to admit doubt or ask for help.

sections.heading: Metal Rooster at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Metal is usually linked with discipline, precision and principled leadership. Metal-year people are often described as the ones who set standards, cut through confusion and finish what they start, which suits law, engineering, finance, surgery, editing and any role that values exactness. They tend to work well alone and lead by example. The traditional caution is inflexibility: a Metal stem can dismiss ideas that arrive untidily, so practising curiosity before judgement usually makes them better leaders.

Since the Rooster's fixed element is Metal, the Metal Rooster is pictured as precision distilled. Law, audit, engineering, military service and editorial standards are its traditional fields, because getting things exactly right is the whole point there. It is relentless about doing things properly, dislikes shortcuts and will happily redo work that others would call finished. In love, it is loyal and honest, sometimes to a fault, and it keeps every promise it makes. It needs respect and plain dealing in return. Friction arises from rigid judgement and a taste for argument: it may debate a point long after winning it, leaving a partner more tired than persuaded.

sections.heading: Metal Rooster years and dates
paragraphs: Between 1924 and 2044 the Metal Rooster years are 1981 (February 5, 1981 to January 24, 1982) and 2041 (February 1, 2041 to January 21, 2042). Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1981 anyone born before Feb 5 is a Metal Monkey, not a Metal Rooster. The combination returns every sixty years, since five elements cycle through twelve animals and only meet the same pairing again after five rounds of the zodiac. Every Metal Rooster year is Yin, matching the Rooster's own polarity.

Chinese almanacs call the combination Xin-You, joining the heavenly stem Xin to the earthly branch You. Births just before each new year fall in the Metal Monkey year (before February 5, 1981) and the Metal Monkey year (before February 1, 2041), and births in the weeks after each Metal Rooster year ends belong to the Water Dog. The new year itself fell on a Thursday in 1981 and Friday in 2041.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Metal Rooster
paragraphs: Metal Roosters usually grow by letting softness in. Deliberately choosing areas of life where 'good enough' is acceptable frees energy for what truly matters. Offering praise as readily as correction transforms how colleagues and family experience them. They may benefit from practices that cultivate gentleness, such as caring for animals, playing music or simply spending unstructured time with friends. Talking about feelings may feel awkward at first, but it deepens their closest bonds. When high standards are held with warmth, Metal Roosters become inspiring, principled leaders. A weekly hour with no agenda at all can be surprisingly healing for them.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Metal Rooster shares the Rooster's San He trine with the Ox and Snake (the Metal trine), its Liu He bond with the Dragon, and its Liu Chong clash with the Rabbit. The element adds a second layer: another Metal sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Metal in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Metal Rooster years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1981 (from February 5, 1981) and 2041 (from February 1, 2041). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Metal Rooster's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Metal and the Rooster's fixed element is Metal; in the five-element cycles metal year element matches the fixed element. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Metal Rooster?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Ox and Snake (San He) and the Dragon (Liu He). The Rabbit is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Metal Rooster called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Xin-You. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Metal stem Xin, followed by its earthly branch, here You for the Rooster, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Metal Rooster different from other Roosters?
faq.answer: All Roosters share precision, candour and diligence. The Metal year element changes the tone: metal is the element of autumn and harvest, and a Metal year is traditionally said to sharpen whatever animal it meets.
